name: Saru no Yume
source:
The protagonist Kurose Madoka (name changeable) has been troubled by a recurring nightmare night after night. A nightmare where someone resembling 'Saotome-kun', the most popular boy in school, brutally murders her. With the help of the Occult Research Club, escape from the nightmares and Saotome! 

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10460]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
主人公黑濑圆（化名）夜复一夜地被反复出现的噩梦所困扰。一场噩梦，类似学校里最受欢迎的男孩“早乙女君”的人残忍地谋杀了她。在超自然研究部的帮助下，逃离噩梦和早乙女！

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/10460]NovelGame[/url]]
